name: Jiyu Gakuen Myonichikan
accessSummary: 5 min walk from Ikebukuro Station Metropolitan Exit (JR, Tokyo Metro Marunouchi / Yurakucho / Fukutoshin Lines, Tobu Tojo Line, Seibu Ikebukuro Line) / 7 min walk from JR Mejiro Station
hours: Usage hours 9:00-21:00 (including setup and cleanup). Closed on Mondays (the next day if Monday is a national holiday or substitute holiday) and over the year-end and New Year holidays. Classrooms and meeting rooms: minimum 2 hours; Dining Hall, Hall and Auditorium: minimum 3 hours; in 30-minute units. Reservations are taken by phone from 9:30 on the day one year before the date of use. (Terms of Use, revised October 2026)
notice: As a nationally designated Important Cultural Property, bringing in or using open flame and smoking are prohibited. Nothing may be attached with nails, pins or tape. There are limits on high-power-consumption equipment and on the volume of musical instruments, and extension beyond the usage time is not allowed. Use for political or religious activities or for selling goods is not allowed. Applications are by phone only, and a site visit is in principle required (Terms of Use, revised October 2026).

ops.loadingHours: Usage time includes setup and cleanup, from entering to leaving the room. Because there is no lobby or waiting room, rent the room from at least 30 minutes before the meeting starts. Extension beyond the usage time is not allowed. Desks and chairs can be moved within the room; the user does this and restores them to their original positions before leaving. (Source: Terms of Use, revised October 2026)
ops.vehicleRules: If a vehicle is used for loading and unloading for facility use, it is by reservation, and the organizer tells the staff in charge.
ops.parking: Under the Terms of Use, if you contact the venue in advance, up to 2 vehicles can use the parking lot during the reserved time only. The access page says there is no dedicated parking lot and to use nearby coin-operated parking lots. (Source: Terms of Use, revised October 2026)
ops.waitingRooms: Myonichikan has no waiting space. Arrive to match the reception time.
ops.catering: Please refrain from bringing in outside food and drink. The venue's meal guide offers boxed lunches (8 people or more; order by 7 days before the date of use), a buffet (standing, 40 people or more), French course meals (seated, 40 people or more), drinks and free-flow drinks, and receptions and parties can be held in the Dining Hall and the Hall. (Source: Terms of Use, revised October 2026; Meal Guide, revised February 2026)
